exposure: antecedents of waking (sounds from newborn, companion, health care team, environment)
contexts of waking (physical and emotional discomfort)
cohort: Fourteen women who had recently given birth and were hospitalized in an academic medical center in the southeastern United States.
finding: Mothers experienced a median of 2.8 hours of total sleep during the 24 hours before hospital discharge, with sleep frequently fragmented by sounds from various sources and difficulty initiating sleep due to physical and emotional discomfort.
cross-section timing: 24 hours before hospital discharge after childbirth
